mapper.insert: insert into category_brand (brand_id, category_id, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{brandId}, #{categoryId}, now(), now(), 0)
mapper.update:
update category_brand set
brand_id = #{brandId},
category_id = #{categoryId},
update_time=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select b.* from category_brand cb INNER JOIN brand b ON cb.brand_id = b.id where cb.category_id=#{categoryId} and b.is_deleted=0
